note: Cham Bank (بنك الشام, Damascus), its approved table of service prices and commissions, issue 2026-01 (the signed PDF, two pages, read by eye: its Arabic text doesn't extract), section on accounts, item 36, account management commission: the current account (الحساب الجاري) costs 100 Syrian pounds a month (1 dollar, 1 euro, 5 dirhams, 5 riyals or half a Kuwaiti dinar a month for an account in that currency); the commission covers the ATM card request, the electronic services subscription, the card account's management and an electronic statement once a month on request. The savings account's is 500 pounds every six months and the salary account's 50 pounds a month; neither is written. The bank's page that introduces the table says it is the approved table, issue 2026-01, that changes are announced in the banking halls and on the site before they apply, and that the PDF is the only reference. The pound here is the table's own: against its dollar column (100 pounds or 1 dollar a month) it reads as the new Syrian pound, not the pound before the redenomination: the site at cb.gov.sy quotes the official rates in the new pound (122 to the dollar on 29 October 2026), though its banner calls it a trial version for display and not the official government site, so that page shows the unit and is not leaned on for anything else. Which pound the game's SYP is in is for the lead to settle; the table's figure is written as it stands.
